headline: Northwest Nazarene stand as the last unbeaten side
dek: Seattle Pacific lost at Regis and Western Washington lost at home to Westminster on the same afternoon, ending the perfect starts both had carried into the day. Northwest Nazarene, who have won twice and drawn three times without losing, are now the only programme in the conference without a defeat.
